annotations.title: Make each network's version of a post

description: Make a version of the post's text for each network its accounts are on, shaped to that network's limits (hashtag cap, caption length). The post's media is kept and media_pending says a cropped or re-timed video is still to come. A network that already has a version for this base is left alone, so a second call adds nothing and never overwrites a person's edit. Published targets are skipped. The post's approvals do not change: approve again to send each network its own version. Networks without a profile (no_profile) keep the post's text.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
